jobs.title: Leader, Strategic Transformation (Workday and Business Transformation)
jobs.description:
Salary

The salary range for this position is CAD $55.25 - $79.42 / hour

Job Summary

Lead Business Transformation and Shape the Future of Healthcare!

Are you a dynamic and strategic leader with a passion for making a positive impact in healthcare? Do you find fulfillment in bringing corporate and clinical partners together to redesign business processes, enable new ways of working, and translate technology investments into meaningful system improvements? If so, we have an incredible opportunity for you to be part of a well-established team and take the lead on enterprise changes that will shape the future of healthcare!

The Opportunity

Bring your initiative, client service focus, systems level thinking and leadership skills to our dynamic team of seasoned project and change professionals. This Leader role is aligned to the Employee Experience portfolio, partnering on people and business-focused transformation priorities across the region. You will support a program of integrated initiatives in the People and Financial Stewardship pillars, partnering strategically on Fraser Health Workday implementation and enterprise changes to improve provider experience and organizational performance.

As Leader within the Strategic Transformation Team, you will lead members of our internal consulting team (senior consultants and coordinators), and partner with executive sponsors (vice-presidents, executive directors, directors and/or medical leaders) across the region to ensure plans for Fraser Health’s highest priority, cross-organizational change initiatives, are successfully designed, implemented, integrated and evaluated. Working with sponsors and operational partners, you will help define success, connect interdependent initiatives, and evaluate the outcomes and business benefits.

What You’ll Do

Our Leaders support diverse portfolios, leading alongside clinical and corporate sponsors to ensure collaboration between cross-functional teams, bringing cutting edge ideas to the table and helping to break down silos. You will help partners translate strategic priorities into an integrated transformation roadmap, understand current-state challenges, and design and implement future-state business processes. Bringing project delivery and change management together, you will connect implementation planning with operational readiness, adoption and sustainment of benefits. Your work will contribute to the improvement of healthcare processes, enhance the quality of patient care, and will make a meaningful difference in the lives of the individuals and communities that Fraser Health serves. Your expertise in leading teams, along with proven, applied skills in project and change management will be the driving force behind transformative initiatives that directly impact patient outcomes and organizational success.

Who We Are: The Strategic Transformation and Project Delivery Team

The Fraser Health Planning & Transformation department values a culture of openness, partnership, creativity and innovation where we recognize each other’s expertise, honour the contributions of everyone and have each other’s back. Your ideas will be welcomed as we collectively strive to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We provide ongoing professional development opportunities and a vibrant and inclusive work environment that supports flexibility and hybrid work models.

The Ideal Candidate For This Role Will

Have an in-depth understanding of the health care system and Fraser Health at both strategic and operational levels. Experience of business transformation, and knowledge of Workday in healthcare considered an asset.
Bring a business transformation lens to project delivery: You've successfully led a complex portfolio of inter-related projects from initiation to completion, demonstrating a keen ability to navigate challenges and deliver exceptional results. You connect delivery milestones with strategic outcomes, manage dependencies and help partners assess whether changes achieve their intended benefits.
Be a change management champion: You have an intentional approach to engage people to move from awareness of a change to adopting and sustaining new ways of working.
Have a passion for healthcare: Your insights will drive projects that directly impact patient care and organizational success. Experience in a large health organization would be beneficial.
Have a collaborative spirit: We believe in the power of teamwork. Your ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and impacted parties is essential for success in this role.
Have a Master’s degree in health administration or a related discipline supplemented with project and change management courses: PMP and Prosci(R) or other certification/designation in leadership, project and change management would be an asset.
Have ten (10) years’ recent, related experience in an environment focused on delivering change/transformation initiatives using project and change management methods in a large, complex environment, including supervision of others.
Have access to a vehicle for business related purposes.

Valued Benefits

Joining our team offers you opportunities to work in a rapidly growing organization, with health professionals who are excellent in their respective fields, career growth and advancement, a competitive compensation package (including four weeks of vacation to start, comprehensive health benefits, and pension plan), and the rewarding opportunity to make a difference every single day in health care.

Detailed Overview

The Leader, Strategic Transformation is the principal agent for change who seeks to shift or transition a major part of the Organization from a current state to a desired future state. The Leader ensures that the plans and goals of the executive sponsor are successfully designed, implemented, integrated and evaluated as they relate to the requested redesign, restructure and reconfiguration of their service area. Where applicable, the Leader may provide subject matter expertise during the client's planning process. The Leader oversees and manages the budget specified for the change process and is required to assemble, direct and supervise a team of Senior Consultants that will ensure the Leader's blueprint for change is done effectively, efficiently, on time and on budget.

Responsibilities

Leads multi-stakeholder, organization-wide strategic initiatives from current state to the desired future state through idea generation, planning, design, implementation and evaluation; provides subject matter expertise and leadership on the strategic initiative to the executive sponsors or sponsor group (e.g., steering committees) throughout the change initiative.
Manages the overall coordination of strategic initiatives from a strategic change context; develops, oversees and manages the overall transformation plan on behalf of the sponsors; where appropriate, co-manages non-Strategic Transformation Team project resources working collaboratively with other support groups in the organization that are critical for the successful execution of the change.
Participates in the recruitment of staff and manages the professional development of employees through the formal assessment of training needs and the development of training plans: responsible to oversee and as required, participate in the management of human resource matters; prepares and conducts performance assessments for the Senior Consultants, Strategic Transformation.
Provides work direction and leadership to a team of Senior Consultants, Strategic Transformation throughout the initiative(s) assigned to them and ensures strategic transformation resource needs are assigned appropriately; secures and manages contractual relationships with external consultants, as needed.
Identifies and manages resources and budgets required to complete strategic transformation work; develops a budget report and schedule for monitoring expenditures and variance analysis of all assigned aspects of the initiative and reports regularly to the sponsor(s).
Identifies and manages key stakeholder strategies and works collaboratively with Communications to develop appropriate communication strategies.
Applies project and change management principles to develop engagement strategies and action plans to maximize likelihood of success; working collaboratively with Organizational Development as required.
Identifies, establishes, and oversees the appropriate team structure and membership required for the strategic transformation initiative(s) including sponsorship, champion, steering committee and delivery/implementation teams, as well as, FH and external resources.
Assesses the impact of strategic transformation initiatives from a systems perspective and manages the impacts and interdependencies with other initiatives happening in FH; supports the Director, Strategic Transformation in the STT prioritization process with the Executive Team.
Develops and/or oversees the development of relevant documentation (e.g., statements of work, proposals, charters, work plans, risk management plans, and change management plans,, etc.); working collaboratively with Health and Business Analytics and other departments on developing effective measurement systems to track progress towards achievement of results/outcomes.
Partners with other departments in the development, maintenance and promotion of the organization's repeatable and sustainable initiative, project, and change management processes.
Participates in the evaluation and refinement of tools and methods utilized by the Strategic Transformation Team, as required; champions the various STT methodologies; assists in the development and presentation of initiative, project, and change management coaching, mentoring and instruction strategies and materials.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Master's degree in Health Administration or related discipline supplemented with project and change management courses. Ten (10) years' experience including five (5) years in a project management role and the supervision of others, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Valid BC Driver's Licence and access to a vehicle for business related purposes.

Competencies

Demonstrates the leadership practices of the Fraser Health Leadership Framework of Clear, Caring and Courageous and creates the conditions for people to succeed.

Professional/Technical Capabilities

Expert knowledge of change and project management principles coupled with an indepth understanding of the healthcare system at both the strategic and operational levels.
Knowledge of other health care disciplines and their role in health care.
Ability to operate a PC and effectively utilize a variety of software applications to support the initiative management activities.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

About Fraser Health

Fraser Health is the heart of health care for over two million people in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley in British Columbia, Canada, on the traditional, ancestral and unceded lands of the Coast Salish and Nlaka’pamux Nations and is home to 32 First Nations within the Fraser Salish region.

People - those we care for and those who care for them - are at the heart of everything we do. Our hospital and community-based services are delivered by a team of 50,000+ staff, medical staff and volunteers.

We are committed to planetary health and value diversity in the work force. We strive to maintain an environment of respect, caring and trust. Fraser Health’s hiring practices aspire to ensure all individuals are treated in an inclusive, equitable and culturally safe manner.

Together, we are the heart of health care.

Job Description

DePuy Synthes is currently recruiting for a Senior Director, Acquisitions & Divestitures (A&D) Finance to ideally be located in Raynham, MA.

The Corporate A&D Finance team is seeking a seasoned, strategic, and influential Senior Director to serve as the enterprise finance thought partner on portfolio shaping and capital deployment decisions across our sectors (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Technologies). This leader will set the financial point of view behind DePuy Synthes’s acquisitions, partnerships, and divestitures, determining how each transaction fits the enterprise strategy, creates sustainable long-term value, and aligns with capital allocation priorities. The Senior Director will partner with corporate and sector executives, Business Development, the A&D Community of Practice, and external advisors to establish valuation frameworks, challenge key assumptions, and deliver clear, decision-ready recommendations to the most senior leaders of the company (GOC, EC/MC, and Board of Directors).

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopedics business to establish a standalone orthopedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic finance advisor to enterprise and sector leaders on portfolio strategy, helping shape the pipeline of acquisitions, partnerships, and divestitures so that it reflects long-term growth objectives, capital allocation priorities, and the evolving competitive landscape. Provide an independent, objective perspective that balances opportunity with risk.
Lead and oversee objective financial and business analyses of new acquisitions, partnering relationships (i.e. options, licenses, equity investments, etc.), and divestitures, ensuring objectivity, transparency, and completeness in strategic assessments, valuations, and due diligence (highlighting both opportunities and risks) as well as transaction closing activities (purchase price allocation, deal financings, etc.). Distill complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations for senior management, the GOC, EC/MC, and the Board of Directors.
Provide senior financial leadership across the full deal lifecycle, guiding deal structuring, contract and purchase price negotiations, valuation, due diligence, EC/MC and BOD presentations, Investor Relations support and framing, EPS analyses, and capital structure impacts. Direct the work of deal teams, external advisors, and investment bankers to ensure transactions deliver the intended value.
Oversee the review of key legal documents and required regulatory filings in support of specific transactions, partnering with Legal, Tax, and Controllership to structure transactions that protect value and manage risk.
Own the vision for, and continuously evolve, the enterprise A&D valuation and decision-making framework. Design, develop, enhance, and implement processes that lead to more accurate valuation assessments, drive value creation, and mitigate risk. This includes driving compliance with EC/MC approved Acquisition and Divestiture processes/standards and ensuring that standardized information is reviewed and output templates are used during investment decision-making meetings (consistency cross-sector, cross deal type).
Drive improved acquisition and divestiture outcomes by leading post-transaction reviews that measure results against the original deal thesis, and by translating lessons learned into process improvements and guidance for management and business development partners.
Lead special enterprise projects of a financial nature as required, including, but not limited to capital allocation analytics, share repurchase programs, cost of capital, dividend proposals, J&J and affiliate valuations, capital structure, credit ratings, etc.
Build and sustain influential relationships with key members of the J&J Finance, Business Development, and A&D Community of Practice teams to foster a culture of objectivity, transparency, and constructive dialogue on financial and valuation matters. Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives and be recognized as a J&J Finance leader and thought partner in the M&A and portfolio management discipline. Demonstrate an open and flexible mindset that inspires creative and innovative solutions while maintaining a value creation discipline. This position works closely with other key M&A oriented groups including the following: Sector BD, A&D Operations, Controllership/GTAAS, Tax, Investor Relations, Legal, HR, third party advisors and investment bankers.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree is required, preferably in Finance, Accounting, or other business-related discipline. If undergraduate degree is not in Finance or Accounting, then an MBA in Finance is highly recommended.
CMA, CPA, CFA and/or an MBA is preferred (or its equivalents).
A minimum of 12 years of finance, accounting or related business experience is required.
BU Finance experience (in Commercial/Supply Chain/R&D finance) at the Senior Manager or Director level is preferred.
Experience with Financial Analysis, Financial Valuation Modeling, and Investment decision-making is preferred.
Ability to understand and interrogate all financial statements and their key linkages is required.
Excellent analytical, communication and business partnership skills as well as the ability to lead and collaborate in a highly matrix environment across multiple sectors, regions, and functions.
Demonstrate the ability to challenge the status quo and provide recommendations to enhance value creation opportunities required.
Strong system skills (i.e. Excel, PowerPoint & Word) are required for this role, along with the ability to work well independently, manage complexity, and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
This position requires a highly motivated individual with strong analytical and research skills, intellectual curiosity and proven leadership capabilities.
The candidate will be principally based out of New Brunswick, NJ and limited domestic and international travel may be required. (10%).

jobs.description:
Job Description

About Agilent

Agilent is a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies, we are passionate about bringing great science to life. We help scientists, researchers, and clinicians address some of the world’s most important challenges across life science research, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, food, environmental testing, and related markets.

Leveraging more than 50 years of expertise, we develop advanced instruments, software, consumables, and services that enable customers to generate reliable scientific results and improve scientific, economic, and operational outcomes. Our global organization combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer impact. We work collaboratively with our customers on their journey to make a real difference in human lives. Our culture is founded on trust, respect, and uncompromising integrity, and we pride ourselves on being a dynamic and inclusive workplace that empowers employees and fosters innovation.

The Role

Agilent is seeking a highly experienced product strategy leader to help define how laboratories will evolve over the next five to ten years and translate that vision into actionable strategies for our businesses and product organizations.

This senior individual contributor works across the enterprise at the intersection of customer insight, science, technology, and business strategy. As a recognized internal expert, you will lead high-impact, long-range initiatives, advise senior leadership, and independently solve complex challenges spanning multiple functions with limited support. You will connect external signals and customer needs with business-group priorities, product roadmaps, and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Assess how AI, automation, robotics, connected instruments, digital workflows, data platforms, and autonomous experimentation could change laboratory work. Identify practical applications in scientific productivity, instrument operation, workflow optimization, decision support, and service; distinguish durable shifts from short-term technology cycles.
Evaluate new products, solutions, partnerships, and business models. Develop strategic and financial cases that assess customer value, differentiation, and feasibility; recommend when to build, partner, invest, acquire, or apply existing capabilities differently.
Develop and continually refine Agilent’s view of Autonomous Labs. Synthesize scientific, technological, economic, and operational trends, including changing workforce models and productivity pressures, into scenarios and implications for our portfolio, business models, and investments.
Engage scientists, laboratory leaders, executives, key opinion leaders, and strategic customers to understand current operations and emerging needs. Identify workflow bottlenecks, fragmented data, automation gaps, usability challenges, and inefficiencies that span individual instruments or product categories.
Synthesize customer feedback across markets and businesses into clear problem statements, strategic requirements, opportunity areas, and investment recommendations. Connect market direction, competitive developments, technology adoption, and laboratory economics to customer value and business opportunity.
Partner with individual business and product groups to translate enterprise insight into specific decisions about what to develop, accelerate, integrate, redesign, partner around, or stop pursuing. Convert recommendations into product concepts, roadmap changes, customer experiments, and investment cases.
Lead initiatives across product management, R&D, commercial, digital, service, and business leadership. Align teams around customer problems that cross organizational boundaries and opportunities to combine instruments, software, consumables, automation, services, and data into more complete solutions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a scientific, engineering, business, or related discipline, or equivalent experience. A PhD, MBA, or equivalent advanced experience is strongly preferred.
Typically 12+ years of relevant combined experience across product strategy, product management, scientific research, strategy consulting, operations, technology, business development, or related fields.
Experience in life sciences, analytical instrumentation, diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, laboratory technology, or adjacent markets is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to understand complex markets, translate trends into business strategy, and turn customer insight into product, portfolio, or organizational action.
A record of delivering results across functions and working credibly with senior business leaders, scientists, engineers, and product teams.

Skills And Competencies

Strategic and systems thinking, with the ability to recognize patterns across markets, customers, technologies, and businesses.
Scientific and technical fluency, curiosity about AI and automation, and sound product judgment grounded in customer needs.
Structured problem solving and analytical rigor; ability to turn ambiguous information into concrete decisions and priorities.
Executive communication, facilitation, and influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
Ability to move between long-range strategy and practical execution, aligning stakeholders and sustaining follow-through.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.

The Director, Product Analytics will lead the Product Analytics function within Group Benefits, with primary accountability for using data and analytics to deepen understanding of our products, customers and members and to support better product and business decisions.

The incumbent will shape the strategy and evolution of Product Analytics, partnering closely with Product, Distribution and other business leaders to provide trusted, relevant and actionable insights across the product lifecycle. The role will help identify emerging trends, understand product performance and customer needs, evaluate opportunities and support decisions that strengthen our Group Benefits products and the value they provide to Canadians.

Through better use of data and insights, the Director will help connect product decisions to customer and member outcomes, supporting the broader ambition of improving the health and well-being of Canadians.

In addition to Product Analytics, the Director will contribute to and lead broader analytics initiatives across Group Benefits where the team's capabilities, data and expertise can create value. Working closely with Product, Distribution, Operations, Data and Technology partners, the Director will lead the development and evolution of analytical capabilities, including advanced analytics, dashboards and reporting, self-service analytics, data products and strategic insights. The role will balance immediate business needs with scalable analytical solutions, strong data governance, appropriate data protection and a clear focus on business and customer value.

The Director will also lead and develop a high-performing analytics team, establishing clear priorities, strengthening analytical capabilities and building a culture focused on curiosity, partnership and measurable business outcomes.

Position Responsibilities

Lead the Product Analytics function and team. Establish priorities and a clear analytics roadmap aligned with Group Benefits' product and business strategies. Coach and develop employees while fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing team.
Partner closely with Product leaders and teams. Understand strategic priorities, opportunities and business questions and translate them into meaningful analytics, insights and recommendations.
Advance the Product Analytics strategy. Evolve the organization beyond traditional reporting toward proactive, insight-driven analytics that influence product strategy, development and ongoing management.
Deepen understanding of product performance and customer needs. Use data to identify trends, opportunities, emerging issues and areas where products or customer experiences can be improved.
Support decisions across the product lifecycle. Bring analytical perspectives to product development, enhancements, portfolio management, customer adoption and ongoing product performance.

Develop and evolve Product Analytics capabilities. Advance dashboards, recurring reporting, exploratory analytics, self-service capabilities, data products and more sophisticated analytical approaches.

Identify emerging analytical opportunities. Partner with business leaders to frame complex or ambiguous questions, assess available data, develop analytical approaches and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

Establish measures of success. Define and monitor business impact, stakeholder value, adoption, analytical effectiveness and continued advancement of capabilities.

Strong experience using data and analytics to support product, customer or business decision-making, with an ability to translate complex information into meaningful insights and recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to apply analytics to a range of business problems, moving comfortably between recurring reporting, exploratory analysis, strategic insights and scalable analytical solutions.
Strong understanding of the Group Benefits business and product landscape, including the needs of customers, members, Distribution partners and internal business stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing an analytics strategy and roadmap that balances immediate stakeholder needs with longer-term opportunities and scalable capabilities.

Strong ability to use data visualization and storytelling to communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience with modern analytics, business intelligence and data technologies, including dashboards, automated reporting and self-service analytical capabilities.

Demonstrated ability to challenge business requests appropriately and prioritize analytical work based on customer value, business value, strategic alignment and organizational capacity.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated ability to establish credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

We are seeking a senior technical leader specializing in building high-performance, interactive data visualization platforms and enterprise reporting engines. This is an expert-level role focused on creating advanced, web-based analytical applications that combine rich, interactive frontends with highly optimized, data-intensive backends and distributed query engines. A mandatory and critical secondary focus of this role is the design and creation of custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. You will build the bridge between LLMs/AI agents and our enterprise data layers, including Starburst, enabling AI to autonomously and securely query, analyze, and report on massive datasets.

Core Responsibilities

You will own the end-to-end design and delivery of sophisticated FinTech tools used directly by investment bankers, front-office traders, and financial analysts. This requires translating complex financial workflows into intuitive, high-fidelity web interfaces. Your primary focus will be on architecting and building highly interactive, web-based analytical dashboards using Angular and React, allowing users to slice, dice, and explore massive datasets in real-time.

A key function is leveraging Starburst (Trino) to query massive, distributed datasets with sub-second latency. You will design and implement robust backend microservices (Java/Spring Boot) optimized for low-latency data retrieval, heavy aggregation, and streaming large datasets to the frontend. Furthermore, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing scalable ETL processes to manage huge volumes of financial data.

A mandatory responsibility is to design, build, and maintain custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools. This enables AI agents and LLMs to securely interface with internal databases, APIs, and reporting engines. You will also architect enterprise-grade document generation engines using the Aspose suite to programmatically create high-fidelity financial reports from complex templates.

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. This includes critically reviewing and taking ownership of all AI-generated code (Java, Angular, React, SQL) to ensure structural integrity, security compliance, and production readiness, while applying a deep functional understanding of Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) to all projects.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

About Agilent

Agilent is a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies, we are passionate about bringing great science to life. We help scientists, researchers, and clinicians address some of the world’s most important challenges across life science research, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, food, environmental testing, and related markets.

Leveraging more than 50 years of expertise, we develop advanced instruments, software, consumables, and services that enable customers to generate reliable scientific results and improve scientific, economic, and operational outcomes. Our global organization combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer impact. We work collaboratively with our customers on their journey to make a real difference in human lives. Our culture is founded on trust, respect, and uncompromising integrity, and we pride ourselves on being a dynamic and inclusive workplace that empowers employees and fosters innovation.

The Role

Agilent is seeking a highly experienced product strategy leader to help define how laboratories will evolve over the next five to ten years and translate that vision into actionable strategies for our businesses and product organizations.

This senior individual contributor works across the enterprise at the intersection of customer insight, science, technology, and business strategy. As a recognized internal expert, you will lead high-impact, long-range initiatives, advise senior leadership, and independently solve complex challenges spanning multiple functions with limited support. You will connect external signals and customer needs with business-group priorities, product roadmaps, and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Assess how AI, automation, robotics, connected instruments, digital workflows, data platforms, and autonomous experimentation could change laboratory work. Identify practical applications in scientific productivity, instrument operation, workflow optimization, decision support, and service; distinguish durable shifts from short-term technology cycles.
Evaluate new products, solutions, partnerships, and business models. Develop strategic and financial cases that assess customer value, differentiation, and feasibility; recommend when to build, partner, invest, acquire, or apply existing capabilities differently.
Develop and continually refine Agilent’s view of Autonomous Labs. Synthesize scientific, technological, economic, and operational trends, including changing workforce models and productivity pressures, into scenarios and implications for our portfolio, business models, and investments.
Engage scientists, laboratory leaders, executives, key opinion leaders, and strategic customers to understand current operations and emerging needs. Identify workflow bottlenecks, fragmented data, automation gaps, usability challenges, and inefficiencies that span individual instruments or product categories.
Synthesize customer feedback across markets and businesses into clear problem statements, strategic requirements, opportunity areas, and investment recommendations. Connect market direction, competitive developments, technology adoption, and laboratory economics to customer value and business opportunity.
Partner with individual business and product groups to translate enterprise insight into specific decisions about what to develop, accelerate, integrate, redesign, partner around, or stop pursuing. Convert recommendations into product concepts, roadmap changes, customer experiments, and investment cases.
Lead initiatives across product management, R&D, commercial, digital, service, and business leadership. Align teams around customer problems that cross organizational boundaries and opportunities to combine instruments, software, consumables, automation, services, and data into more complete solutions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a scientific, engineering, business, or related discipline, or equivalent experience. A PhD, MBA, or equivalent advanced experience is strongly preferred.
Typically 12+ years of relevant combined experience across product strategy, product management, scientific research, strategy consulting, operations, technology, business development, or related fields.
Experience in life sciences, analytical instrumentation, diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, laboratory technology, or adjacent markets is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to understand complex markets, translate trends into business strategy, and turn customer insight into product, portfolio, or organizational action.
A record of delivering results across functions and working credibly with senior business leaders, scientists, engineers, and product teams.

Skills And Competencies

Strategic and systems thinking, with the ability to recognize patterns across markets, customers, technologies, and businesses.
Scientific and technical fluency, curiosity about AI and automation, and sound product judgment grounded in customer needs.
Structured problem solving and analytical rigor; ability to turn ambiguous information into concrete decisions and priorities.
Executive communication, facilitation, and influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
Ability to move between long-range strategy and practical execution, aligning stakeholders and sustaining follow-through.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.
